hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.sh) bash -n "$f" || exit 2;; *.rs) rustfmt --edition 2021 "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && for f in spikes/*.sh; do [ -e "$f" ] && { bash -n "$f" || { echo "syntax error in $f" >&2; exit 2; }; }; done; if [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo test || exit 2; fi
